digest.component_or_area: applier dispatch routing for non-create operation families
propositions: Non-create operation families (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict) must route through coordinator and endpoint-failure scoped fuse instead of legacy ad-hoc retry nesting, with per-family internal rollback selector and no dual-send.
Remaining matching plans deferred by the fuse must preserve explicit scope, reason, and retry_not_before metadata, while independent scopes continue unblocked.

All per-mutation guards (lost-lease abort_check, HEAD-drift recheck, rebar-id audit) and batch-precondition guards (cross-project, blast-radius) must remain in force at identical enforcement points relative to each physical mutation.
Applied, failed, deferred, skipped, and recovered plan tallies must be exact, with degraded pass signaling preserved through CutoverReport mapping.
Historical replay of 1,200-run completed slice must show zero premature termination of observed successful or partially successful work when normalized to terminal outcomes.

Venue-gated Cloud/DC verified-fake tests must exercise the coordinator cutover (coordinate_and_fuse with guarded execute closure) for summary updates through both Cloud and DC backends, asserting wire output and five-bucket tallies before the coordinator default is enabled.
